import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyConnectingClass
import MumfordLib.SimplicialCohomologyCupConnecting

/-!
# The singular Mayer--Vietoris connecting map and cup products

Multiplication by a global cocycle on the right commutes with the connecting
map. Cochain lifts exist by simplicial Mayer--Vietoris, and the subdivision
comparison lifts their glued differential to a global singular cocycle.
The signed Leibniz identity has no remaining sign for this right action.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory HomologicalComplex

namespace Mumford.Analytic

/-- An overlap cocycle has a cochain lift whose differentials are represented
by the restrictions of an ordinary singular cocycle. -/
theorem singularCocycle_exists_mayerVietoris_lift
    (X : TopCat) (U V : Set X) (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ) (n : ℕ)
    (γ : singularCocycles (TopCat.of (U ∩ V : Set X)) n) :
    ∃ (α : IntegralSimplicialCochain (singularSubset X U) n)
      (β : IntegralSimplicialCochain (singularSubset X V) n)
      (θ : singularCocycles X (n + 1)),
      simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference
          (singularSubset X U) (singularSubset X V) n (α, β) =
        simplicialCochainPullback
          ((SSet.Subcomplex.eqToIso (singularSubset_inter X U V)).inv ≫
            (singularSubsetIso X (U ∩ V : Set X)).inv) n γ.1 ∧
      simplicialCochainUnionRestriction
          (singularSubset X U) (singularSubset X V) (n + 1)
          (simplicialCochainPullback
            (singularSubset X U ⊔ singularSubset X V).ι (n + 1) θ.1) =
        (simplicialCochainDifferential (singularSubset X U) n α,
          simplicialCochainDifferential (singularSubset X V) n β) := by
  let f := (SSet.Subcomplex.eqToIso (singularSubset_inter X U V)).inv ≫
    (singularSubsetIso X (U ∩ V : Set X)).inv
  obtain ⟨α, β, θ, hγ, hθ⟩ := simplicialCocycle_exists_mayerVietoris_lift
    (singularSubset X U) (singularSubset X V) n (simplicialCocyclePullback f n γ)
  have hlift := smallSingularCocycle_exists_lift (n := n + 1)
    (fun b : Bool => if b then U else V) (by
      intro b
      cases b <;> assumption) (by
      intro x
      have hx : x ∈ U ∪ V := hcover ▸ Set.mem_univ x
      rcases hx with hx | hx
      · exact ⟨true, hx⟩
      · exact ⟨false, hx⟩)
  rw [smallSingularSubcomplex_two] at hlift
  obtain ⟨η, hηclosed, hη⟩ := hlift θ.1 θ.2
  refine ⟨α, β, ⟨η, hηclosed⟩, hγ, ?_⟩
  change simplicialCochainUnionRestriction _ _ (n + 1)
    (simplicialCochainPullback _ (n + 1) η) = _
  rw [hη]
  exact hθ

private theorem simplicialCochainCup_sub_left {K : SSet} {p q n : ℕ}
    (φ χ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K p) (ψ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K q)
    (h : p + q = n) :
    simplicialCochainCup (φ - χ) ψ h =
      simplicialCochainCup φ ψ h - simplicialCochainCup χ ψ h := by
  exact congrArg (fun F => F ψ) ((simplicialCochainCupBilinear K p q n h).map_sub φ χ)

private theorem simplicialCochainCup_differential_of_right_cocycle
    {K : SSet} {p q n : ℕ} (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K p)
    (ψ : simplicialCocycles K q) (h : p + q = n) :
    simplicialCochainDifferential K n (simplicialCochainCup φ ψ.1 h) =
      simplicialCochainCup (simplicialCochainDifferential K p φ) ψ.1 (by omega) := by
  rw [simplicialCochainCup_differential, ψ.2]
  simp

private theorem singularIntersectionComparison_inclusion
    (X : TopCat) (U V : Set X) :
    ((SSet.Subcomplex.eqToIso (singularSubset_inter X U V)).inv ≫
      (singularSubsetIso X (U ∩ V : Set X)).inv) ≫
        TopCat.toSSet.map (singularSubsetInclusion X (U ∩ V : Set X)) =
      (singularSubset X U ⊓ singularSubset X V).ι := by
  rw [Category.assoc, ← singularSubsetIso_hom_ι, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  rfl

/-- At the level of arbitrary cocycle representatives, the actual singular
connecting map commutes with cup by a global cocycle on the right. -/
theorem singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_cup_class
    (X : TopCat) (U V : Set X) (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ) {p q n : ℕ} (h : p + q = n)
    (γ : singularCocycles (TopCat.of (U ∩ V : Set X)) p)
    (ψ : singularCocycles X q) :
    singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting X U V hU hV hcover n
      (singularCohomologyClass _ n
        (singularCocycleCup γ
          (singularCocyclePullback (singularSubsetInclusion X (U ∩ V : Set X)) q ψ) h)) =
      singularCohomologyCup X (p + 1) q (n + 1) (by omega)
        (singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting X U V hU hV hcover p
          (singularCohomologyClass _ p γ))
        (singularCohomologyClass X q ψ) := by
  let A := singularSubset X U
  let B := singularSubset X V
  let f := (SSet.Subcomplex.eqToIso (singularSubset_inter X U V)).inv ≫
    (singularSubsetIso X (U ∩ V : Set X)).inv
  let ψA := simplicialCocyclePullback A.ι q ψ
  let ψB := simplicialCocyclePullback B.ι q ψ
  obtain ⟨α, β, θ, hγ, hθ⟩ := singularCocycle_exists_mayerVietoris_lift
    X U V hU hV hcover p γ
  have hδ := singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_class_of_lift
    X U V hU hV hcover p γ α β θ hγ hθ
  rw [hδ, singularCohomologyCup_class]
  apply singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_class_of_lift
    X U V hU hV hcover n _
    (simplicialCochainCup α ψA.1 h) (simplicialCochainCup β ψB.1 h)
    (singularCocycleCup θ ψ (by omega))
  · change simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE inf_le_left) n
        (simplicialCochainCup α ψA.1 h) -
      simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE inf_le_right) n
        (simplicialCochainCup β ψB.1 h) =
      simplicialCochainPullback f n
        (simplicialCochainCup γ.1
          (simplicialCochainPullback
            (TopCat.toSSet.map (singularSubsetInclusion X (U ∩ V : Set X))) q ψ.1) h)
    rw [simplicialCochainPullback_cup, simplicialCochainPullback_cup,
      simplicialCochainPullback_cup, ← simplicialCochainPullback_comp,
      singularIntersectionComparison_inclusion]
    change simplicialCochainCup (simplicialCochainPullback _ p α)
        (simplicialCochainPullback _ q (simplicialCochainPullback A.ι q ψ.1)) h -
      simplicialCochainCup (simplicialCochainPullback _ p β)
        (simplicialCochainPullback _ q (simplicialCochainPullback B.ι q ψ.1)) h = _
    rw [← simplicialCochainPullback_comp, ← simplicialCochainPullback_comp]
    change simplicialCochainCup (simplicialCochainPullback _ p α)
        (simplicialCochainPullback (A ⊓ B).ι q ψ.1) h -
      simplicialCochainCup (simplicialCochainPullback _ p β)
        (simplicialCochainPullback (A ⊓ B).ι q ψ.1) h = _
    rw [← simplicialCochainCup_sub_left]
    change simplicialCochainCup (simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B p (α, β))
      (simplicialCochainPullback (A ⊓ B).ι q ψ.1) h = _
    rw [hγ]
  · have hθA : simplicialCochainPullback A.ι (p + 1) θ.1 =
        simplicialCochainDifferential A p α := by
      have ht := congrArg Prod.fst hθ
      change simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_left) (p + 1)
        (simplicialCochainPullback (A ⊔ B).ι (p + 1) θ.1) = _ at ht
      rw [← simplicialCochainPullback_comp] at ht
      exact ht
    have hθB : simplicialCochainPullback B.ι (p + 1) θ.1 =
        simplicialCochainDifferential B p β := by
      have ht := congrArg Prod.snd hθ
      change simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_right) (p + 1)
        (simplicialCochainPullback (A ⊔ B).ι (p + 1) θ.1) = _ at ht
      rw [← simplicialCochainPullback_comp] at ht
      exact ht
    apply Prod.ext
    · change simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_left) (n + 1)
        (simplicialCochainPullback (A ⊔ B).ι (n + 1)
          (simplicialCochainCup θ.1 ψ.1 (by omega))) =
        simplicialCochainDifferential A n (simplicialCochainCup α ψA.1 h)
      rw [← simplicialCochainPullback_comp, SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE_ι,
        simplicialCochainPullback_cup]
      erw [hθA]
      rw [simplicialCochainCup_differential_of_right_cocycle]
      rfl
    · change simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_right) (n + 1)
        (simplicialCochainPullback (A ⊔ B).ι (n + 1)
          (simplicialCochainCup θ.1 ψ.1 (by omega))) =
        simplicialCochainDifferential B n (simplicialCochainCup β ψB.1 h)
      rw [← simplicialCochainPullback_comp, SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE_ι,
        simplicialCochainPullback_cup]
      erw [hθB]
      rw [simplicialCochainCup_differential_of_right_cocycle]
      rfl

/-- The ordinary singular Mayer--Vietoris connecting map is linear for the
right cup action of global cohomology classes. -/
theorem singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_cup
    (X : TopCat) (U V : Set X) (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ) {p q n : ℕ} (h : p + q = n)
    (c : IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (U ∩ V : Set X)) p)
    (d : IntegralSingularCohomology X q) :
    singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting X U V hU hV hcover n
      (singularCohomologyCup _ p q n h c
        (singularCohomologyPullback (singularSubsetInclusion X (U ∩ V : Set X)) q d)) =
      singularCohomologyCup X (p + 1) q (n + 1) (by omega)
        (singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting X U V hU hV hcover p c) d := by
  obtain ⟨γ, rfl⟩ := singularCohomologyClass_surjective _ p c
  obtain ⟨ψ, rfl⟩ := singularCohomologyClass_surjective X q d
  rw [singularCohomologyPullback_class, singularCohomologyCup_class]
  exact singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_cup_class X U V hU hV hcover h γ ψ

private theorem singularUnionCohomologyIso_class
    (X : TopCat) (U V : Set X) (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ) (n : ℕ) (φ : singularCocycles X n) :
    (singularUnionCohomologyIso X U V hU hV hcover n).hom
      (singularCohomologyClass X n φ) =
      simplicialCohomologyClass _ n
        (simplicialCocyclePullback (singularSubset X U ⊔ singularSubset X V).ι n φ) := by
  rw [singularUnionCohomologyIso_hom, ← simplicialCohomologyClass_toSSet]
  exact simplicialCohomologyClass_pullback _ n φ

private theorem singularConnecting_restrict_class
    (X : TopCat) (U V : Set X) (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ) (n : ℕ)
    (γ : singularCocycles (TopCat.of (U ∩ V : Set X)) n) :
    (singularUnionCohomologyIso X U V hU hV hcover (n + 1)).hom
      (singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting X U V hU hV hcover n
        (singularCohomologyClass _ n γ)) =
      simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting (singularSubset X U) (singularSubset X V) n
        (simplicialCohomologyClass _ n (simplicialCocyclePullback
          ((SSet.Subcomplex.eqToIso (singularSubset_inter X U V)).inv ≫
            (singularSubsetIso X (U ∩ V : Set X)).inv) n γ)) := by
  have hinput : (singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso X U V hU hV hcover n).hom.τ₃
      (singularCohomologyClass _ n γ) =
      simplicialCohomologyClass _ n (simplicialCocyclePullback
          ((SSet.Subcomplex.eqToIso (singularSubset_inter X U V)).inv ≫
            (singularSubsetIso X (U ∩ V : Set X)).inv) n γ) := by
    change (homologyMap
      (integralSimplicialCochainPullback (singularSubsetIso X (U ∩ V : Set X)).inv) n ≫
      homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback
        (SSet.Subcomplex.eqToIso (singularSubset_inter X U V)).inv) n)
          (singularCohomologyClass _ n γ) = _
    rw [← homologyMap_comp, ← integralSimplicialCochainPullback_comp,
      ← simplicialCohomologyClass_toSSet]
    exact simplicialCohomologyClass_pullback _ n γ
  have htransport : singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting X U V hU hV hcover n ≫
      (singularUnionCohomologyIso X U V hU hV hcover (n + 1)).hom =
        (singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso X U V hU hV hcover n).hom.τ₃ ≫
          simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting
            (singularSubset X U) (singularSubset X V) n := by
    simp only [singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting,
      singularCohomologyMayerVietorisIso_inv_τ₁, Category.assoc,
      Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
    rfl
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, htransport]
  erw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, hinput]
  rfl

/-- Cup by a global cocycle on the left commutes with the singular connecting
map with the sign of the global cocycle's degree. -/
theorem singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_cup_left_class
    (X : TopCat) (U V : Set X) (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ) (p q : ℕ)
    (φ : singularCocycles X p)
    (γ : singularCocycles (TopCat.of (U ∩ V : Set X)) q) :
    singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting X U V hU hV hcover (p + q)
      (singularCohomologyClass _ (p + q)
        (singularCocycleCup
          (singularCocyclePullback (singularSubsetInclusion X (U ∩ V : Set X)) p φ)
          γ rfl)) =
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ p • singularCohomologyCup X p (q + 1) (p + q + 1) (by omega)
        (singularCohomologyClass X p φ)
        (singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting X U V hU hV hcover q
          (singularCohomologyClass _ q γ)) := by
  let A := singularSubset X U
  let B := singularSubset X V
  let f := (SSet.Subcomplex.eqToIso (singularSubset_inter X U V)).inv ≫
    (singularSubsetIso X (U ∩ V : Set X)).inv
  let φ' := simplicialCocyclePullback (A ⊔ B).ι p φ
  let γ' := simplicialCocyclePullback f q γ
  obtain ⟨α, β, θ, hγ, hθ⟩ := singularCocycle_exists_mayerVietoris_lift
    X U V hU hV hcover q γ
  let θ' := simplicialCocyclePullback (A ⊔ B).ι (q + 1) θ
  have hδ := singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_class_of_lift
    X U V hU hV hcover q γ α β θ hγ hθ
  rw [hδ, singularCohomologyCup_class]
  apply (singularUnionCohomologyIso X U V hU hV hcover (p + q + 1)).toLinearEquiv.injective
  change (singularUnionCohomologyIso X U V hU hV hcover (p + q + 1)).hom _ =
    (singularUnionCohomologyIso X U V hU hV hcover (p + q + 1)).hom _
  rw [map_zsmul, singularConnecting_restrict_class, singularUnionCohomologyIso_class]
  have hcupInput : simplicialCocyclePullback f (p + q)
      (singularCocycleCup
        (singularCocyclePullback (singularSubsetInclusion X (U ∩ V : Set X)) p φ)
        γ rfl) =
      simplicialCocycleCup
        (simplicialCocyclePullback
          (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE (inf_le_left.trans le_sup_left)) p φ') γ' rfl := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change simplicialCochainPullback f (p + q)
      (simplicialCochainCup
        (simplicialCochainPullback
          (TopCat.toSSet.map (singularSubsetInclusion X (U ∩ V : Set X))) p φ.1)
        γ.1 rfl) =
      simplicialCochainCup
        (simplicialCochainPullback _ p (simplicialCochainPullback (A ⊔ B).ι p φ.1))
        (simplicialCochainPullback f q γ.1) rfl
    rw [simplicialCochainPullback_cup, ← simplicialCochainPullback_comp,
      singularIntersectionComparison_inclusion, ← simplicialCochainPullback_comp]
    rfl
  have hcupOutput : simplicialCocyclePullback (A ⊔ B).ι (p + q + 1)
      (singularCocycleCup φ θ (by omega)) = simplicialCocycleCup φ' θ' (by omega) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact simplicialCochainPullback_cup (A ⊔ B).ι φ.1 θ.1 (by omega)
  erw [hcupInput, hcupOutput]
  exact simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_cup_left_of_lift
    A B p q φ' γ' α β θ' hγ hθ

/-- The signed left action of global singular cohomology commutes with the
ordinary Mayer--Vietoris connecting map. -/
theorem singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_cup_left
    (X : TopCat) (U V : Set X) (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ) (p q : ℕ)
    (c : IntegralSingularCohomology X p)
    (d : IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (U ∩ V : Set X)) q) :
    singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting X U V hU hV hcover (p + q)
      (singularCohomologyCup _ p q (p + q) rfl
        (singularCohomologyPullback (singularSubsetInclusion X (U ∩ V : Set X)) p c) d) =
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ p • singularCohomologyCup X p (q + 1) (p + q + 1) (by omega) c
        (singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting X U V hU hV hcover q d) := by
  obtain ⟨φ, rfl⟩ := singularCohomologyClass_surjective X p c
  obtain ⟨γ, rfl⟩ := singularCohomologyClass_surjective _ q d
  rw [singularCohomologyPullback_class, singularCohomologyCup_class]
  exact singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_cup_left_class X U V hU hV hcover p q φ γ

end Mumford.Analytic
